alternative_explanations: Any apparent gain may be ordinary target-side SA from the supplied constant vector, extra coarse-space capacity, target matrix feature computation, or classical recycling rather than information transferred from foreign source matrices; the role contrasts and controls isolate these explanations.
confounds: Only one transition exists per application slot and target size is confounded with slot, so the quick is screening evidence and cannot establish a scaling law or broad PDE generality.
falsification_criteria: Discard if any learned role fails residual 1e-7 on any target.
Discard unless shared improves independent and cross-family-only improves support-only by at least max(1e-9, 10 percent of comparator residual) on every target without an iteration increase.

Discard if shared is implementably Pareto-dominated, regresses worst-target iterations versus target standard SA, or lacks an R16 workload win over the best complete standard/adaptive target rebuild on at least two targets.

Invalidate on source-identity failure, target metadata or outcome leakage, constant drift, post-score tuning, missing mandatory control, external model or API, preflight failure or evaluator-integrity mismatch.

outcome_policy.negative: A valid negative closes the exact mechanism without tuning feature depth, relaxation steps, ridge, candidate count, source subset or PyAMG settings and returns the program to search mode.
outcome_policy.null: A null or mixed result closes this exact foreign-source local near-nullspace rule because the preregistered every-target causal transfer signature is absent.
outcome_policy.positive: A strong positive would justify unchanged three-seed replication of this exact local feature, relaxation-label, ridge and two-vector construction; it would not yet support promotion.

predicted_outcome: The shared and cross-family-only roles will produce at least max(1e-9, ten percent of comparator residual) lower residual than their source-identical same-source controls on every target without more iterations, while shared remains Pareto-nondominated and wins R16 workload against target rebuild on at least two targets.
promotion_criteria: A quick cannot promote; a strong positive only authorizes unchanged three-seed replication, followed by a preregistered adversarial and cross-family test.
research_question: Does one source-identical local near-nullspace map learned from multiple anonymous real sparse source operators causally improve held-out certified solves beyond same-source fit, target-adaptive SA and classical hierarchy recycling at full R16 cost?

invalidation_rules: Invalidate if any held-out target or target-derived outcome is visible during fit.
Invalidate if an implementable role receives group, matrix name, application kind, pair identity, geometry, PDE label, path, hand-written near-nullspace or family-specific constants.
Invalidate unless shared, independent, cross-family-only and support-only use one implementation and constants and differ only in evaluator-selected source matrices.
Invalidate if a result omits acquisition, fit, hierarchy build or update, every sparse solve operation, bytes, resident and peak state or R1 R4 R16 workload.

Invalidate on residual above the declared quality gate being treated as success, post-score tuning, seed leakage, missing control, baseline semantic mismatch, preflight mismatch or evaluator-integrity change.

title: Cross-application anonymous local near-nullspace transfer quick
